    		    		<div data-elementor-type="wp-page" data-elementor-id="2802" class="elementor elementor-2802">
						<section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-261dbd0 elementor-section-height-min-height elementor-section-stretched elementor-section-items-bottom elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default" data-id="261dbd0" data-element_type="section" data-e-type="section">
							<div class="elementor-background-overlay"></div>
							<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
					<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-7ddabfd" data-id="7ddabfd" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column">
			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d610bbb elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="d610bbb" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h1 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">The hotel Villa Aloha</h1>				</div>
				</div>
					</div>
		</div>
					</div>
		</section>
				<section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-6677e27 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="6677e27" data-element_type="section" data-e-type="section" data-settings="{&quot;hoteller_ext_is_background_parallax&quot;:&quot;false&quot;,&quot;hoteller_ext_is_background_backdrop&quot;:&quot;false&quot;,&quot;hoteller_ext_is_background_on_scroll&quot;:&quot;false&quot;}">
						<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
					<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-66 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-3717267" data-id="3717267" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column">
			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1182470 elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="1182470" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">accommodation and restaurants</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-9b73195 elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="9b73195" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p><strong>Hotel Villa Aloha</strong> enjoys a privileged location facing the <strong>kitesurf spot</strong>. The terrace of your room opens on the wild dunes and the azure ocean. A preserved and contrasted nature is revealed. The mangrove, the river, the vast beaches awaken the senses and provide a real change of scenery.</p><p>The <strong>hotel</strong> welcomes you in spacious bungalows of 25 m² for 2 or 3 people well oriented and ventilated. They have a bathroom, a queen-size bed and a single bed. They all have a sea view and a terrace with hammock and deck chair. Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.</p><p>Breakfasts are served in the hotel restaurant as a buffet. Throughout the day, the bar offers refreshments and snacks. At night, you can enjoy a caipirinha &#8211; a famous Brazilian cocktail &#8211; at the hotel bar.<br />Nearby, beach restaurants open for lunch and dinner offer typical Brazilian dishes. The surrounding nature delivers the ingredients for a healthy and tasty food consisting of seafood, fish and exotic fruits.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0d3fb93 elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="0d3fb93" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">discover the local culture</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c033628 elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="c033628" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>In addition to <strong>kitesurfing</strong>, you can enjoy various activities related to the traditional way of life of Brazilians.<br />Thus, the &#8220;vaqueiros&#8221;, brazilian cowboys propose their horses and invite to change of atmosphere to the discovery of a green hinterland and galloping on the beach.<br />At dawn, the fishermen go out to sea for a few hours. Embark aboard their traditional small sailboat for a lobster hunt or a fishing session.</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
		</div>
				<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-33 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-9ad4a42" data-id="9ad4a42" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column">
			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-9eabb8f elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="9eabb8f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Prices</p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-77e3236 elementor-widget elementor-widget-toggle" data-id="77e3236" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="toggle.default">

				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
